newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse turnover up 8.85pct y/y in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse turnover up 8.85pct y/y in Nov.

text.p: Turnover at the main market of the Athens bourse was up 8.85 percent year-on-year but down 7.39 percent month-on-month, Ionian Research said in a statement.
Turnover at the parallel market fell 57.72 percent to 6.093 billion drachmas month-on-month in November.
Turnover at the Athens bourse rose 55.03 percent to 1.544 trillion drachmas in the period January-November, it said.
It should be noted that trading at the Athens stock exchange was halted or lasted for a few minutes for three sessions in November.
Private ErgoBank and Alpha Credit Bank were the leaders in share marketability at 7.42 percent and 2.25 percent respectively in the same month. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
